hero.heading: Building stronger brands through
hero.text: Mackman Group combine business consultancy, market research, brand expertise, marketing strategies and HR into an extension of your business.

about.heading: One business consultancy, three divisions
about.text:
Mackman Group is a premier full-service business consultancy dedicated to the growth of premium brands and the individuals within them. We specialise in developing bespoke programs tailored for ambitious brands seeking growth, whether through upscaling, mergers and acquisitions, preparing for sale, or attracting investment.

With a foundation built on strategy, insight, and expertise, we empower brands to reach new heights, surpass their goals and develop stronger relationships with key audiences. What sets Mackman Group Business Consultancy apart is our unwavering commitment to delivering exceptional results, honed over two decades of industry experience.

Our blended business consultancy projects bring together the diverse talents of our divisional directors, ensuring a holistic approach to every project. Key specialisms include market research, brand strategies, strategic marketing, and human resources.

At Mackman Group, we take pride in our ethical approach, demonstrating that profitability and social responsibility can go hand in hand. We operate with a triple bottom line perspective, considering the impacts on People, Planet, and Profit in all that we do.

items.title: Market research consultancy services
items.text: Mackman Research Market Research Agency is East Anglia's leading market research company, conducting employee research, customer research, perception and satisfaction surveys, engagement benchmarking, and recommending strategies to improve organisational excellence. Our data-driven insights drive business growth and bring brands closer to their audiences.

items.title: Branding and marketing consultancy services
items.text: Mackman Branding & Marketing Agency is our targeted and strategic-led branding & marketing agency. The multidisciplinary team provides a full-service partner that can act as a complete outsourced marketing department or interface with existing in-house resources.

items.title: HR consultancy services
items.text: Red Kite HR Services provides all the benefits of an in-house professional with the flexibility of an expert consultant. Our HR specialist offers reliable, personalised, practical HR support with clear direction to work seamlessly with internal management.

items.title: Training and coaching
items.text: Training is delivered across our range of divisional specialisms with bespoke programmes directly aligned with your business needs. They are designed to unlock the full potential of internal teams and embed best practice.

standards.heading: Consistent quality across every sector
standards.text:
Mackman Group has worked with clients from all sectors, from government bodies to international businesses, to scale up enterprises and charitable organisations. We have decades of experience working with business-to-business and business-to-consumer brands.

To assure our business partners of consistent service quality, we have embedded processes to ensure we adhere to quality standards. These are defined by:

items.name: Chartered Institute of Personnel and Development

testimonial.quote: Clients tell us that they value our plain speaking, collaborative, problem-solving capabilities and our ability to generate long-term growth.
